description: Header file for Adobe's CFF Interpreter, defining functions and structures related to font hinting and character string interpretation in the FreeType project.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_isValid
methods.description: Checks if a CF2_HintMask is valid.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_isNew
methods.description: Checks if a CF2_HintMask is new.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_setNew
methods.description: Sets the 'new' status of a CF2_HintMask.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_getMaskPtr
methods.description: Retrieves the mask pointer from a CF2_HintMask.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_setAll
methods.description: Sets all bits in a CF2_HintMask.

methods.name: cf2_interpT2CharString
methods.description: Interprets a Type 2 CharString for font rendering.
